specs.Specific Uses For Product: [INFERRED] Home entertainment, multimedia streaming, TV audio enhancement

features: The primary justification for finding entertainment indoors is the Zeb-Juke bar 9550, which allows you to spend more time curled up on the couch watching your favorite shows

Supreme-quality sound and top-notch acoustics are mainly because of the high power output capacity of the Jukebar. This soundbar’s power is as massive as 625W distributed as 75W from each of the triple drivers, 75W output from each of the dual wireless rear satellites, and 125W output from each of the dual wireless subwoofers

This soundbar's potent triple drivers, spanning 9x5.8cm, are a source of delightful audio-quality streaming. The subwoofer's 16.51cm (6.5”) driver and dual satellites of driver size 5.8x9 cm each can produce detailed sound
With its 5.2 CH output and Dolby Audio, this soundbar is here to provide you with amazing surround sound. It's the ideal option for streaming music, watching movies, and more

Multi connectivity feature will now allow you to connect various compatible devices to this soundbar and experience detailed audio like never before. Thanks to this feature, including audio-streaming via Bluetooth v5.3, transmitting your television sound to the speaker with HDMI ARC, AUX, and Optical Input, and using your USB pen drive of memory up to 32GB
This soundbar's user interface is reinforced with an LED display which displays the operating mode and controls of the speaker
This soundbar can be wall-mounted so, it comes with a wall-mount bracket and a fastener, making your desk space free!
The colorful RGB LED lights on the soundbar will allow you to light up your living room in hues
